parts.title: Clock input clamp
parts.description: BAT54S dual Schottky clamp. Reviewed revJ mapping: pin 1 = GND, pin 2 = +3.3 V, pin 3 = common at the clock-input buffer network.

parts.title: Diode / indicator
parts.description: Light emitting diode, small symbol

parts.title: Diode / indicator
parts.description: Light emitting diode, small symbol

parts.title: Battery charger / power path
parts.description: BQ24075 Li-ion charger and power-path manager. VBUS enters from J4, VBAT connects to J16, and VYS feeds the selectable power path.

parts.title: Headphones
parts.description: 6.35 mm TRS headphone output from the SGTL5000 codec. Tip is left, ring is right. Sleeve uses the codec headphone virtual ground, HP_VGND.
parts.caution: The sleeve is HP_VGND, not the board GND net.

parts.title: I²C / peripheral header
parts.description: 5-contact 2.54 mm socket. Shared bus pinout: GND, +5 V, SDA (GPIO18), SCL (GPIO19), and GPIO27. All eight sockets share these same nets.

parts.title: MIDI input
parts.description: 3.5 mm TRS MIDI input. The signal feeds the TLP2361 optocoupler U4 through the input protection network. The sleeve pad is unconnected.

parts.title: USB device / power
parts.description: USB-C device port: D+ and D− connect to the Teensy device pogo contacts CN2 and CN1. VBUS feeds the charging and power circuit. R9 and R10 are 5.1 kΩ CC pull-downs.

parts.title: Stereo line output
parts.description: 6.35 mm TRS line output. Left and right codec signals are AC-coupled through C17 and C16. Sleeve is GND.

parts.title: Stereo line input
parts.description: 6.35 mm TRS line input. Tip and ring feed the codec line-input network through C19 and C18. Sleeve is GND.

parts.title: External microphone
parts.description: 6.35 mm microphone input. Tip feeds the microphone path through C20; the normalled tip contact carries MICBIAS. Ring is unconnected.

parts.title: microSD storage
parts.description: Hirose microSD socket wired for SPI: CS on Teensy GPIO10, MOSI on GPIO11, MISO on GPIO12, and SCK on GPIO13. Supply is +3.3 V.

parts.title: Switched 5 V + GPIO
parts.description: 3-pin JST PH. Pin 1 goes through R20 (220 Ω) to Teensy GPIO17; pin 2 is GND; pin 3 is the output of the TPS22918 load switch U8. U8 is enabled by GPIO36.
parts.caution: Pin 3 is switched power. The PCB does not give this connector a more specific functional name.

parts.title: Speaker output
parts.description: 2-pin JST PH connected to the PAM8403 amplifier’s right-channel bridge outputs: pin 1 to U13 pin 14 (ROUT+), pin 2 to U13 pin 16 (ROUT−).
parts.caution: Both pins are amplifier outputs; neither pin is GND.

parts.title: GPIO breakout · 3.3 V
parts.description: 5-pin JST PH: GPIO24, GPIO25, GPIO31, +3.3 V, GND. The nearby silkscreen reads “I2S2-3V”; the table preserves the actual PCB net names.

parts.title: GPIO 22 / 5 / 15
parts.description: 5-pin JST PH breakout: GPIO22, GPIO5, GPIO15, +3.3 V and GND. Alternative peripheral functions are preserved in the pin net names.

parts.title: Touch buttons
parts.description: Five touch-button inputs for the standard panel (exttouch=false). Pin 1: Touch 1 / Single (GPIO2). Pin 2: Touch 3 / Record (GPIO4). Pin 3: Touch 2 / Menu (GPIO3). Pin 4: Touch 4 / Audition (GPIO6). Pin 5: Touch 5 / FN (GPIO39). Mapping verified against docs/BUILD.md and platformio/toern.ino.
parts.caution: No power or GND pin. OUT2, BCLK2 and LRCLK2 in the PCB net names are alternate GPIO functions; the standard firmware uses these pins for the touch panel.

parts.title: GPIO 14 / 9 / 16
parts.description: 5-pin JST PH breakout: GPIO14, GPIO9, GPIO16, +3.3 V and GND. Aliases include SPDIF_OUT and SCL1; actual behavior depends on firmware.

parts.title: GPIO 33 / 32 / 41
parts.description: 5-pin JST PH breakout: GPIO33, GPIO32, GPIO41, +3.3 V and GND. Net aliases include MCLK2, OUT1B and A17.

parts.title: Battery
parts.description: 2-pin JST PH battery connector. Pin 1 is GND; pin 2 is VBAT, connected to the BQ24075 charger / power-path IC.

parts.title: MIDI output
parts.description: 3.5 mm TRS MIDI output. Pin 2 connects through R7 to the MIDI output driver; pin 3 connects through R8 to +3.3 V. Pin 1 is GND.

parts.title: Clock output · 5 V
parts.description: 2-pin JST PH labeled CLK-OUT(5V). Signal travels from GPIO37 through U15 (74AHCT1G125) and R28. Pin 2 is GND.

parts.title: Clock input · 3–5 V
parts.description: 2-pin JST PH labeled CLK-IN(3-5V). Pin 1 feeds R30, the BAT54S clamp D2, and the Schmitt buffer U14, then Teensy GPIO38. Pin 2 is GND.
parts.caution: 3–5 V is the board’s silkscreen label, not a new electrical qualification.

parts.title: Sidechain output · 5 V
parts.description: 2-pin JST PH labeled SIDEC-5V. Pin 1 is driven by GPIO28 through U16 (74AHCT1G125) and R32. Pin 2 is GND.

parts.title: USB host
parts.description: The revJ USB-C host port. VBUS is 5V-HOST; data is D+HOST and D-HOST. These signals connect to the Teensy host pogo row CN3–CN7. R11 and R33 are separate 56 kΩ CC pull-ups.
parts.caution: This is the host port. The design README specifies no additional CC controller or carrier VBUS switch.

parts.title: GPIO breakout · 5 V
parts.description: 5-pin JST PH sharing GPIO24, GPIO25 and GPIO31 with J11. Pin 4 is +5 V instead of +3.3 V. Nearby silkscreen reads “I2S2-5V”.
parts.caution: The supply differs from J11. The GPIO nets are shared directly; a 5 V supply label does not establish 5 V GPIO tolerance.

parts.description: Three-pad solder jumper. Center pad feeds S1; outer pads select USB VBUS or charger output VYS.

parts.description: Electret microphone capsule connected to the codec microphone and bias circuitry. Inspect the pad nets for its exact carrier connections.

parts.title: 1.8 V regulator
parts.description: SPX3819 linear regulator: +5 V input to the +1V8 rail.

parts.title: Audio codec
parts.description: SGTL5000 stereo audio codec. Connects the Teensy digital audio interface to line input, line output, headphones and microphone circuitry.

parts.title: MIDI optocoupler
parts.description: TLP2361 optocoupler in the MIDI input path, separating the incoming MIDI current-loop signal from the controller-side logic.

parts.title: MIDI logic buffer
parts.description: 74LVC2G14 dual inverting Schmitt trigger used in the MIDI circuitry. Select a pin to inspect its direct net connections.

parts.title: Teensy 4.1
parts.description: Main controller module. Its carrier footprint exposes the numbered GPIO, audio buses and power rails. CN1/CN2 pick up device USB data; CN3–CN7 pick up the USB host interface.
parts.caution: The pad table describes the carrier footprint. The detailed Teensy 3D assembly is a visual model, not a netlist for the module internals.

parts.title: Digital 3.3 V regulator
parts.description: SPX3819 linear regulator: +5 V input to the +3.3V rail.

parts.title: Switched peripheral power
parts.description: TPS22918 load switch. +5 V enters pin 1, GPIO36 controls ON at pin 3, and output pin 6 supplies J9 pin 3.

parts.title: Speaker amplifier
parts.description: PAM8403 class-D stereo amplifier. The carrier uses its right-channel bridge output at J10. GPIO30 connects to the amplifier shutdown input.

parts.title: Clock input buffer
parts.description: 74LVC1G17 Schmitt buffer between the protected clock input network and GPIO38.

parts.title: Clock output driver
parts.description: 74AHCT1G125 buffer supplied by +5 V. Drives J25 through R28 from GPIO37.

parts.title: Sidechain driver
parts.description: 74AHCT1G125 buffer supplied by +5 V. Drives J27 through R32 from GPIO28.
